image a(x, y)
    desc a0 = x walk=(32, 16)
    desc a1 = y walk=(32, 8)
    vfill a0 -> l1[0]
    vbar
    vunpk v0 <- l1[0] f16
    vunpk v1 <- l1[8] f16
    vadd v2, v0, v1
    vpack v2 -> l1[16] f16
    vsync drain on=pack
    vdrain a1 <- l1[16]
    halt

image b(x, z)
    desc a0 = x walk=(32, 16)
    desc a1 = z walk=(32, 8)
    vfill a0 -> l1[0]
    vbar
    vunpk v0 <- l1[0] f16
    vunpk v1 <- l1[8] f16
    vmul v2, v0, v1
    vpack v2 -> l1[16] f16
    vsync drain on=pack
    vdrain a1 <- l1[16]
    halt

fn t.l1(x: f16[256] @dram, y: f16[128] @dram, z: f16[128] @dram)
    send vc[0]
        run a(x, y)
    send vc[0]
        run b(x, z)
    barrier
